title: Law Of Banking And Insurance Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process utilized by large financial service provider to assess the eligibility of a customer to receive their products."
Underwriting is the process utilized by large financial service provider to assess the eligibility of a customer to receive their products.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a formal request to an insurance company demanding for payment to be made to the insured or beneficiary under an insurance policy."
An insurance claim refers to a formal request to an insurance company demanding for payment to be made to the insured or beneficiary under an insurance policy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the right of the insurer to invite other insurers with which the insured had taken out a policy, to share or contribute to indemnify an insured for the occurrence of a risk that was insured against."

Contribution is the right of the insurer to invite other insurers with which the insured had taken out a policy, to share or contribute to indemnify an insured for the occurrence of a risk that was insured against.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to accidental death and dismemberment insurance that involves the payment of a specified sum of money on the death or injury of the insured."
Accident insurance refers to accidental death and dismemberment insurance that involves the payment of a specified sum of money on the death or injury of the insured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract of indemnity aimed at insuring property against the risk of fire."
Fire insurance policy is a contract of indemnity aimed at insuring property against the risk of fire.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as cover note."
The temporary cover is referred to as cover note.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract of indemnity and the most complex of all insurance contracts."
Marine insurance is a contract of indemnity and the most complex of all insurance contracts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the foundation of an insurance contract and without it, there can be no basis for issuing a legal insurance cover to an insured."
Insurable interest is the foundation of an insurance contract and without it, there can be no basis for issuing a legal insurance cover to an insured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the periodic payment made on an insurance policy by the insured."
Premium is the periodic payment made on an insurance policy by the insured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special class of insurance agent who acts in a professional capacity as an intermediary to arrange insurance cover for the insured."
An insurance broker is a special class of insurance agent who acts in a professional capacity as an intermediary to arrange insurance cover for the insured.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the circumstances in which an insurance company tries to recoup expenses for a claim it paid out when another party should have been responsible for paying at least a portion of that claim."

Subrogation in insurance parlance refers to the circumstances in which an insurance company tries to recoup expenses for a claim it paid out when another party should have been responsible for paying at least a portion of that claim.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement relating to facts at the time the contract of insurance was entered into."
An affirmative warranty is a statement relating to facts at the time the contract of insurance was entered into.
fib: ______ is a statement about future or facts that will continue to be true during the subsistence or term of the policy.
promissory warranty
A promissory warranty is a statement about future or facts that will continue to be true during the subsistence or term of the policy.
______ is the most popular type of insurance in Nigeria.
Motor vehicle insurance
Motor vehicle insurance is the most popular type of insurance in Nigeria.
______ is an assurance by one party to the other party that certain facts or conditions are true or will occur.
warranty
A warranty is an assurance by one party to the other party that certain facts or conditions are true or will occur.

Liability insurance

cover note

Insurance
Insurance is a Specie of business that specifically deals with risk management.

Fire insurance policies
Fire insurance policies are a necessity due to the ever present danger of fire outbreak.

insured

insurance contract
